🔥🇲🇽 <u>PRI'S SECRET POLICE SPIED ON SHEINBAUM SINCE CHILDHOOD</u>

Contralínea opens a series on the DFS archives at the Archivo General de la Nación: Mexico's "political police" surveilled presidents, writers, journalists, even cartel bosses — and Claudia Sheinbaum, in the files since age six, when her mother Annie Pardo took her to visit Lecumberri's political prisoners. Pardo, expelled from the Politécnico after '68, was labeled a "communist." Even Félix Gallardo carried a DFS agent ID. That was the old regime: espionage as state policy.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>FGR NETS INGEMAR'S LEGAL REP IN RUFFO FUEL-SMUGGLING CASE</u>

Mexico's FGR detained Guadalupe Hernández Hinojosa, legal representative of Ingemar — the firm majority-owned by PAN ex-governor Ernesto Ruffo at the heart of the rail-tanker fuel smuggling ring. Prosecutors say she ran foreign trade operations "declaring hydrocarbon volumes significantly lower than those actually transported" and was an authorized signer on the company's bank accounts. Ruffo and eight co-defendants are already facing trial.

🇲🇽🏫 <u>MEXICO DOUBLES HIGH SCHOOL GOAL: 400,000 NEW PLACES</u>

Claudia Sheinbaum just doubled Mexico's public high school expansion target — from 200,000 to 400,000 new places this sexenio. "Many young people who finish middle school still don't have a high school near home. They have to travel very far, and that keeps them out of school. Young people have to be in school," she said inaugurating a new campus in Texcoco. SEP chief Mario Delgado: 20 campuses built, 30 under construction, 4.3 million students on Benito Juárez scholarships — "the most important scholarship plan in Mexico's history."

🇲🇽🔑 "There were 30 requirements for an Infonavit mortgage. We left zero. An 18-year-old with six months of contributions can buy a home." — Octavio Romero Oropeza, Infonavit Director, Puebla 75% of homes being delivered go to buyers aged 18–39. Infonavit's housing fund has grown from 140 billion pesos in 2018 to 1.13 trillion today, so new homes carry no financing cost — a unit worth 1.2 million commercially sells for just over 600,000. In Puebla: 12,000 homes contracted, 30,000 more coming in 49 projects across 18 municipalities.

🇲🇽🏗️ "First we thought 500,000 homes. Then one million. Now the goal is 1.8 million homes — and we are already building 30% of it." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Vivienda para el Bienestar, Puebla In Puebla the plan is 68,950 homes, 27% already contracted. Today's host development, Lomas de San Miguel (photo), grows from 832 to 1,216 homes after the state donated adjacent land. Across the whole housing program — new homes, titles, improvements, restructured credits — 12 million families will benefit, a third of Mexico's households.

🇲🇽🏠 "She borrowed 89,000 pesos. She paid back 246,000 — and still owed 1.6 million. How much does she owe now? Zero." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Vivienda para el Bienestar, Puebla Nearly 5 million families were trapped in "unpayable" Infonavit and FOVISSSTE mortgages — loans that grew even as people paid. All 4.86 million credits were restructured as of Dec 31, 2025. In Puebla, 131,000 families are already clear, and 111,400 more are getting their mortgage released free of charge.

🌐🇲🇽 The Multipolar Financial System Is Being Built — Without Asking Washington

BRICS meets in New Delhi on September 12–13 with a "second batch" of members set to join its current eleven. Over 30 countries are in the queue — Venezuela formally applying, Colombia already inside the New Development Bank, a lender that has deployed US$42.9 billion across 139 projects since 2016. The bloc already commands ~40% of global GDP at purchasing-power parity and nearly half of humanity.

The deeper shift is plumbing: a cross-border payment framework piloted this year links national systems for settlement in local currencies — no dollar required, no common currency imposed. India offered its UPI rails as the model.

For Mexico, none of this means joining a club. It means the world now has more than one door. When the US threatens tariffs to force a choice, sovereignty is the ability to trade with everyone — the EU deal, dialogue with Beijing, an open hand to a multipolar South. Options are the strategy.
